An incomplete critical awaiter registers the resumption delegate through ICriticalNotifyCompletion.UnsafeOnCompleted.
After registering an incomplete awaiter's continuation, await suspends evaluation.

quote_json: "control is returned to the current caller"
requirement: After registering an incomplete awaiter's continuation, await returns control to the async function's current caller.
If the task was already complete, await immediately evaluates the awaiter's GetResult.

quote_json: "upon later invocation of the resumption delegate"
requirement: If the task was incomplete, await evaluates the awaiter's GetResult when the resumption delegate is invoked.
If GetResult returns a value, that value is the result of await.
If GetResult returns no value, await has no result value.
An awaiter's completion-interface methods should invoke the resumption delegate at most once.
notes: The source uses should rather than shall; this is an awaiter recommendation.

quote_json: "behavior of the enclosing async function is undefined"
requirement: The enclosing async function has undefined behavior if the awaiter invokes the resumption delegate more than once.
notes: Undefined is the source term; it is not narrowed to unspecified or implementation-defined outcomes.
